status: complete_read_only_review; front acceptance still requires parent fixes and new exports
scope: Read-only shared-code review of all34 Pixel profiles. Only research/pixel-shared-front-review.json modified. No Blender, profile/trace edits, source edits, exports or publication. Pixel11ProXL roll experiment remains parent-owned.

summary.note: Initial commentary counts were off by one; these are the exact final counts. Current exports predate pending shared code; failures are not proof that pending generation fails.

findings.title: Imported Pixel10Pro bypasses front calibration
findings.impact: Updating the trace changes OLED and metadata, but not imported front glass or the two selfie meshes. The0.20mm rim stays too thin. Camera hit rejection disagrees with the actual physical disk; native UV math is not the cause.
findings.tiny_proposed_fix: After traced_screen at build.py:569 and imported object linking, parent front-calibration hook should update only named front-glass mesh and Selfie objects. Align both optical centers to screen center plus measured cutout and aperture radius to measured outer radius. Preserve independently evidenced inner lens size, rear optics, logos, ports, dimensions and materials. Source-generator equivalents are front slab at build_model.py:134 and selfie disks at155-156. front_rail_mm in a profile alone cannot affect this imported branch.
findings.confidence: High for GLB geometry/camera mismatch. Medium for artwork material boundary, approximately2px uncertainty; not CAD.

findings.title: Cutout loader works but most existing traces still omit measured cutouts
findings.evidence: 27 installed masks measured directly;23 matching trace JSONs lacked screen_cutouts_mm at snapshot. Pixel7Pro retained radius1.5 versus measured2.042905mm and localY73.761322 versus74.099816. Pixel10Pro retained radius1.72 versus measured2.355404mm. Per-ID measurements are retained below.
findings.tiny_proposed_fix: No new build.py fallback needed. Owning family workers should populate screen_cutouts_mm from installed masks, including[] when no hole, and persist through trace/generator path. Keep coordinates screen-local and native resolution fixed. Parent must separately align imported physical optics.
findings.confidence: High; concurrent family workers may already have corrected data after this snapshot.

findings.title: Tracing alone does not add layered selfie optics or antenna seams
findings.evidence: Circular procedural cutouts remain a single .025mm black disk placed .025mm above OLED. Current exports have zero antenna-named nodes in33 profiles and four0.7mm-wide side ribbons in Pixel10Pro. Procedural enclosure construction has no seam-material/mesh step; node-name absence alone would not exclude face-assigned seams.
findings.tiny_proposed_fix: At existing circular-aperture branch330-331, parent production hook should use measured outer aperture plus separately evidenced smaller optical layers. Apply family-specific rail seam/material detail after curved-front deformation. Do not generalize Pixel9/10 seam positions or optical dimensions across all34.
findings.confidence: High for code and existing artifact inventory; internal physical optical dimensions are not established.

findings.title: Curved Pixel6Pro glass and OLED use different X origins
findings.evidence: OLED x is screen-local; glass/enclosure x is parent-local. Pixel6Pro traced screen cx=.0498327759mm, yielding about.0492mm maximum depth disagreement. Pixel7Pro cx=0 is unaffected.
findings.tiny_proposed_fix: At223 change x=abs(vertex.co.x/MM) to x=abs(vertex.co.x/MM-cx) for current parent-centered slab parts. If a curved part ever has nonzero local X translation, include that translation before subtracting cx.
findings.confidence: High mathematical mismatch; not a Blender-rendered visual finding.

findings.title: Original unfolded Fold front camera clips landscape body
findings.evidence: Body158.7x139.7mm; camera AUTO fit with landscape output takes ortho_scale139.7mm as width, cropping9.5mm per side. All other assigned body bounds are portrait.
findings.tiny_proposed_fix: Set camera_data.sensor_fit='VERTICAL' before height-based ortho_scale at606. Keep all render/native resolutions and UVs unchanged. Alternative AUTO fix is max(body width,body height), but VERTICAL matches existing height convention.
findings.confidence: High from source configuration and documented AUTO fit; not rendered. This concerns saved front camera framing, not GLB model scale.

findings.title: Verifier cannot yet accept all34 fronts
findings.evidence: Imported Pixel10Pro passes while its measured body error is.2429mm and rail/camera are wrong. Foldables are excluded from contour branch. SDK-frame alpha assertions prove opaque bezel, not colored rail, seam/camera alignment or metal/glass boundary. Fallback SVG hardcodes.7mm inset while geometry uses max(front_rail_mm,.95*front_roll).
findings.tiny_proposed_fix: Keep.10mm tolerance. Add imported node lookup for 'Body | aluminum enclosure' and actual contour comparison, as an explicit failing diagnostic until parent settles imported front correction. Fold checks must compare panel-local contours to apply_trace results. Add exported resolution equality to matching profile spec near95 and actual aperture center/radius checks. Verify colored rail against measured boundary and actual glass/enclosure, not alpha or metadata alone.
findings.confidence: High. Do not distort reviewed rear/body merely to force the imported check to pass.

accepted_pending_logic.result: Correct: independent body contour survives and sync_slab_body_corners returns early. Old pop/comment at159-161 is unreachable for traced profiles, not a regression.

Curved6/7Pro now follow traced row intersections. Current trace fit boxes have exact native aspect; no viewport or native-resolution rescaling is needed. Radius controls sampling density, not traced silhouette.
Flat traced UV math is correct. Actual current GLB screens all retain0..1 UV bounds; fold halves partition that range. Imported camera mismatch is object/metadata alignment, not UV mapping.

Correct contour normalization, glTF X,-Z conversion and tolerance for20 current traced procedural slabs. Pure traced_ring replay has maximum chassis hull error below.10mm. Do not loosen tolerance to accept old exports.

ring_inset_answer.answer: Shapely inward offset does not inflate inner corner radius. Independent chassis is the correct basis, but a uniform body-minus-rail offset is still an assumed glass boundary, not a measurement of outerglass.
observations: All20 replayed traced-slab OLED footprints fit inside generated black-glass footprints.
Inset resampling differs from exact offset by about.04-.106mm; worst Pixel6a.1057mm. Chassis convex-envelope errors stay below.10mm.

rail=max(.7,.95*front_roll) often leaves no planar aluminum shelf: visible rim is rolled surface. Lowering roll at constant glass inset can reveal a shelf without changing OLED bezel. Parent owns Pixel11XL experiment.

geometry.py:64 snaps to nearest existing vertex instead of exact centroid-ray hit; Pixel6Pro ring starts atY16.93mm. Corresponding points show tangential bridging shear up to2.58mm over1.6mm roll, but checked adjacent-ring steps are below.46mm. This is not evidence of gross inner-radius distortion.
ring_inset_answer.optional_tiny_fix: Only if actual shading/seam twist warrants it: geometry.py:64-67 can interpolate from line.project(Point(hx,hy)), using (start_distance+i*line.length/count)%line.length. Preserve polygon offset and bounding-box rescaling. No broad rewrite required.
ring_inset_answer.limits: No new corner render. Curved6Pro bright inner artwork band can be glass reflection; do not classify aluminum by luminance alone.

frame_measurements.note: RGB x24=[64,68,82],x26=[0,0,2],x28=[74,74,74],x32=[0,0,0];x60 transparent. OLED opening is not metal boundary.

seam_evidence.independently_verified_imported_geometry: Four side ribbons at parentY+52/-60mm,0.7mm axial width,6.5mm depth coverage; no top/bottom antenna nodes.
seam_evidence.scope: Family workers own complete seam extraction. No shared or family seam data edited/generalized. Apply final measured seams after curved-front deformation.

sources.access: Local installed SDK masks/frames read directly. Web tool could not open Pixel6Pro/10Pro directory URLs; upstream binary freshness not independently established.
Previously collected project evidence, not newly measured product photography.
Official API documentation browsed for AUTO/HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL camera fit.

performed: Pure CPython AST execution of trace/outline functions with Shapely; no Blender/bpy.
Read GLB JSON/BIN positions/UVs for34 exports.
Ran existing verify_pixels.verify once per assigned profile:15 pass,19 fail at traced chassis assertion.
Measured27 installed mask.webp interior opaque components.
Measured Pixel10Pro actual body contour and official-frame metal/glass/OLED scanline.

No full suite, public/gallery changes or publication.
No product-photo downloads and no blanket license claim.
